Barcelona midfielder Alexia Putellas has won the 2026 Women’s Ballon d’Or, taking the prestigious award for the third time in her career. The Spain international was named the world’s best women’s footballer at the 2026 Ballon d’Or ceremony, adding to the titles she won in 2021 and 2022.
